newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq stocks end off as focus turns to blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq stocks end off as focus turns to blue chips.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks finished lower on Tuesday as Wall Street focused on large-capitalization blue chips stocks instead of high-technology names.
The Nasdaq composite ended with a one-point decline at 1366, on a day when the Dow industrials soared 78 points to a record closing high of 7067.

Traders said that investors, wary of the market's heights, were putting their money in large, lower-risk stocks. "It's not that they're not playing techs, it's just that they're more heavily playing the cyclicals and the consumer stocks and those tend to be the blue chip stocks," one trader said.

Some of the Nasdaq heavyweights emerged unscathed, including Intel Corp, up 1/8 at 154-5/8, and Cisco Systems Inc, up 1-1/8 to 63-3/4. But Microsoft Corp shed 1/2 to 97-3/8 and Sun Microsystems Inc fell 7/8 to 33-3/4.

Companies with disappointing news were hammered. Atlas Air Inc finished down 10 at 24-1/4. Analysts said the company told them it expected its first-quarter results to show little change from the same period last year.
Boyds Wheels Inc said it expects its 1996 net income to be lower than forecast. It ended down 4-3/8 to 9-7/8.
